rows.role_title: Президент Российской Федерации — President of the Russian Federation
rows.text: Citing Article 92(2) of the Constitution, the President states that he ceases to exercise the powers of the President of the Russian Federation from 12:00 on 31 December 1999; the decree takes effect on signature and is signed 'Президент Российской Федерации Б.Ельцин', Moscow, Kremlin, 31 December 1999, No. 1761.
rows.locator: Point 1; point 3; signature and date block

rows.role_title: Исполняющий обязанности Президента Российской Федерации — Acting President of the Russian Federation
rows.text: Citing Article 92(3), the decree states that the powers of the President are temporarily exercised by the Chairman of the Government of the Russian Federation from 12:00 on 31 December 1999.
